sentences.en: The children were in the garden after school.
sentences.zh: 放学后孩子们在花园里。

sentences.en: They ran and jumped on the green grass.
sentences.zh: 他们在绿色的草地上跑跳着。

sentences.en: The sun was bright.
sentences.zh: 太阳很明亮。

sentences.en: The trees gave them shade.
sentences.zh: 树给他们提供了阴凉。

sentences.en: A black dog ran with them.
sentences.zh: 一只黑狗和他们一起跑。

sentences.en: It was happy.
sentences.zh: 它很快乐。

sentences.en: One boy had a ball and they played a game.
sentences.zh: 一个男孩有一个球，他们玩了一个游戏。

sentences.en: They laughed and shouted with great pleasure.
sentences.zh: 他们大笑着喊叫着，非常开心。

sentences.en: The youngest girl was too small to run fast.
sentences.zh: 最小的女孩太小了，跑不快。

sentences.en: Her brother gave her a flower from the tree.
sentences.zh: 她的哥哥从树上摘了一朵花给她。

sentences.en: A bird sang a song from the branch above them.
sentences.zh: 一只鸟在他们头上的树枝上唱歌。

sentences.en: The children played until the sky turned dark.
sentences.zh: 孩子们一直玩到天空变暗。

sentences.en: Their mother called them in for dinner.
sentences.zh: 他们的妈妈叫他们进去吃饭。

sentences.en: It was the best part of the day for them.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，那是这一天中最美好的时光。

sentences.en: The children jumped with joy.
sentences.zh: 孩子们高兴地跳了起来。

sentences.en: One boy gave the ball a hard kick.
sentences.zh: 一个男孩用力踢了一下球。

sentences.en: The girl slipped on the wet grass.
sentences.zh: 女孩在湿草地上滑倒了。

sentences.en: The ground had a slope near the trees.
sentences.zh: 树附近的地面有一个斜坡。

sentences.en: The ball started to roll down the slope.
sentences.zh: 球开始滚下斜坡。

sentences.en: The children were full of amusement.
sentences.zh: 孩子们充满了快乐。

sentences.en: They pushed and pulled in a friendly way.
sentences.zh: 他们友好地推拉着。

sentences.en: The noise of their laughter was loud but happy.
sentences.zh: 他们笑声很大但很快乐。

sentences.en: The quiet girl did not make a sound.
sentences.zh: 那个安静的女孩没有发出声音。

sentences.en: The baby was too small to play.
sentences.zh: 宝宝太小了不能玩。

sentences.en: It sat and watched.
sentences.zh: 它坐着看。

sentences.en: The children ran to see who was fastest.
sentences.zh: 孩子们跑步看谁最快。

sentences.en: I made a comparison of the two balls.
sentences.zh: 我比较了两个球。

sentences.en: One of them was bigger.
sentences.zh: 其中一个更大。

sentences.en: The children did a trick with a rope.
sentences.zh: 孩子们用绳子变了一个戏法。

sentences.en: One boy used a whistle to make a loud sound.
sentences.zh: 一个男孩用哨子发出很大的声音。

sentences.en: The girl blew the paper across the table.
sentences.zh: 女孩吹动了桌子上的纸。

sentences.en: The bubble burst when the boy touched it.
sentences.zh: 男孩一碰，泡泡就破了。

sentences.en: A drop of water fell from the tree.
sentences.zh: 一滴水从树上滴落。

sentences.en: The child made a slow walk across the grass.
sentences.zh: 孩子慢慢地走过草地。

sentences.en: Do not slip on the wet floor.
sentences.zh: 不要在湿滑的地板上滑倒。

sentences.en: The ball made a smash as it hit the window.
sentences.zh: 球撞到窗户时发出撞击声。

sentences.en: Smoke came from the fire in the garden.
sentences.zh: 花园里的火冒出了烟。

sentences.en: The toy had a spring inside that made it jump.
sentences.zh: 玩具里面有一个弹簧让它跳起来。

sentences.en: The child had an impulse to run and play.
sentences.zh: 孩子有一种冲动去跑和玩。

sentences.en: The children used a rod to hit the ball.
sentences.zh: 孩子们用一根棍子打球。

sentences.en: A net was put up to catch the ball.
sentences.zh: 挂了一个网来接球。

sentences.en: A bucket of water was on the ground.
sentences.zh: 一桶水在地上。

sentences.en: The crack in the ball made it go flat.
sentences.zh: 球上的裂纹让它漏气了。

sentences.en: Do not crush the flowers.
sentences.zh: 不要压碎花朵。

sentences.en: The net had a space between each knot.
sentences.zh: 网在每个结之间有一个空隙。

sentences.en: The rhythm of the song made us all move.
sentences.zh: 歌曲的节奏让我们都动了起来。
